The '''Gamor system''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chaykin sector/Legends|Chaykin sector]]. It lay on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] and served as one endpoint of the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] around the Gamor system was considered well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] as early as [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and the system was the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of the Gamor system|victory]] over the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sect during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. During the following [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the Gamor system fell within the spheres of influence of various governments, and in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] it came under the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
The Gamor [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Chaykin sector/Legends|Chaykin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay between the [[Allanteen system/Legends|Allanteen]] and [[Milagro system/Legends|Milagro systems]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as a dividing line between the regions known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] system also formed one endpoint of the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Merren system/Legends|Merren system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:GamorGSW.png|thumb|left|300px|The Republic was victorious over the Sith in the Gamor system during the Great Sith War.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Gamor system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], although the system itself had already been under the control of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] by [[25,200 BBY]]. The Gamor system became a battleground during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]], when, following a [[Battle of the Denon system|victory]] over the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sect in the [[Denon system/Legends|Denon system]], the [[Corellian fleet (Great Sith War)|Corellian fleet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] traveled along the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Run toward Gamor and [[Battle of the Gamor system|defeated]] the Sith there as well. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], fought [[3956 BBY|forty years]] later, the system lay within the territory claimed by [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Gamor system fell within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and, as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic's [[Sixteenth Army|Sixteenth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy in the system's vicinity.<ref name="TEGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Gamor system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> The system was located within space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

The population of the Gamor system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] was between 10 billion to 100 billion. During the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|galactic conquest]] carried out by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Yuuzhan Vong military forces passed through the Gamor system before attacking the [[Osarian system|Rhommamool]] and [[Tynnani system|Tynna systems]]. The Gamor system remained under the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] of those invaders by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Essential_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Gamor system was introduced in ''The Essential Atlas''.]]
The Gamor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-14.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />

The [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] introduced an erroneous spelling of "Gamorr" for the Gamor system,<ref name="EOTE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> which was repeated the following year in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.<ref name="AOTR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> In addition, both of those books,<ref name="EOTE" /><ref name="AOTR" /> as well as the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' roleplaying game, contained a map of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in which the placements of the Milagro and [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana systems]] had been mistakenly switched, thereby erroneously depicting the latter as the Gamor system's closest [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] neighbor on the Corellian Run hyperlane.<ref name="F&D">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
